how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to model demand for trips between origins and destinations to create a data-driven approach for developing a cycle network and to cross-reference with public engagement feedback to identify where interventions have the greatest potential to improve journeys.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The council allocated a £1.5 million investment in walking and cycling for the 2022/23 financial year to support the development and delivery of the first set of improvements identified in the plan.
pct_usage_quote: The ‘Go-Dutch’ Scenario has been used to understand which routes provide the greatest potential.
local_authority_name: The Royal Borough of Windsor & Maidenhead
